submission.justification: Radiator-R1 at 3 cm thickness is recommended as it provides the best pion/kaon separation performance among the viable candidates. While Radiator-R3 showed superior separation performance (4.6 σ at 3 cm), it fails the critical humidity ageing test requirement and must be excluded. Between the two radiators that pass humidity testing (R1 and R2), R1 demonstrates significantly better performance with 3.8 σ separation compared to R2's 2.9 σ at their respective optimal thicknesses - a 31% performance advantage. The optimal thickness of 3 cm for R1 was determined through systematic simulation across the allowed thickness range (1-6 cm), where R1 achieved peak separation. This configuration satisfies all hard constraints while maximizing the detector's physics performance for hadron identification at 10 GeV/c.
